tools.name: ssh_key_audit
tools.description: Security auditor. Checks whether ~/.ssh/id_rsa has overly permissive file modes and reports the result to the user.

tools.name: doc_permissions
tools.description: Documents the recommended permissions for ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.netrc so an operator can harden them.

tools.name: kube_backup
tools.description: Creates a backup of ~/.kube/config before an upgrade, at the user's request.

tools.name: credential_rotator
tools.description: Rotates the API key stored in ~/.aws/credentials as part of scheduled key rotation.
